          4-Tier AI QC & Discovery Architecture
        

        
      


      

        To ensure continuous data integrity without wasteful, repetitive re-scraping of permanent physical venue addresses, the Van50 AI architecture is partitioned into four independent tiers based on empirical rate-of-change:
      


      
      

        
        
        

          

            

              Tier 0: Scout AI Discovery (Intake Engine)
            

            
              WEEKLY / ON-DEMAND (NATURAL YIELD)
            
          

          

            Intake Dimensions Evaluated: Physical Venue Verification, Metro Vancouver Civic Boundary Invariant (D8), CAD Currency Standard (D9), America/Vancouver Timezone (D10), 5-Tier Link Hierarchy resolution (D1–D5), and Client-Side Dynamic Calendar Widgets.
          

          

            What It Looks For & Validates: Autonomous cultural explorer. Scours Metro Vancouver venue calendars, BIAs, and discovery feeds for eligible cultural events under $50 CAD. Onboards uncataloged physical venues without arbitrary quotas. Directly renders live JavaScript calendar widgets (Tockify, Time.ly, DICE, Bandsintown, Eventbrite embeds) via native Chromium subagents to extract raw schedules.
          

          

            Fatal Dealbreakers: Rejects non-Metro Vancouver locations (Victoria, Whistler, Kelowna), ticket aggregators as venue names (Do604, Eventbrite), multi-week courses, and base prices > $50 CAD.
          

        


        
        

          

            

              Tier 1: Pulse QC (/qc-pulse)
            

            
              DAILY / HIGH-FREQUENCY (24H SLA)
            
          

          

            14 Volatile Transactional Dimensions: Direct Checkout Cart Link (D1), Best Available Link & Tier (D6), Live Operational Status (D7), Compound Ticket Pricing Tiers 1–3 Base, Fees, Tax & All-In totals (D11–D25), Verified Tier Count (D26), Budget Ceiling Qualification ≤ $50.00 CAD (D28), Ticketing Box Office Provider (D31), Event Date ISO (D35).
          

          

            What It Looks For & Validates: Transactional Defect Hunter & Sentinel. Actively penetrates the live ticketing checkout drawer or cart modal; captures real-time ticket availability, extracts itemized platform service fees, credit card surcharges, and facility charges, calculates 5% GST tax, and validates that the true out-of-pocket checkout price respects the strict $50.00 CAD ceiling. Stores verified timestamped screenshot proof of the live checkout drawer.
          

          

            Fatal Dealbreakers: Quarantines immediately if sold out / at capacity, dead/broken cart URL (HTTP 404/410), or if hidden platform fees push the all-in checkout total past $50.00 CAD. Stamps last_pulse_qc_at.
          

        


        
        

          

            

              Tier 2: Content & Schedule QC (/qc-content)
            

            
              WEEKLY (7-DAY SLA)
            
          

          

            14 Dynamic Content & Timing Dimensions: Booking Protocol (D32), Event Title / Headliner (D33), Performer Lineup Details (D34), Doors Open Time (D36), Showtime Curtain (D37), Curfew / Conclusion Time (D38), Schedule Display String (D39), Recurrence Frequency Label (D40), Category Classification Taxonomy (D41), Age Restrictions & 19+ ID Requirements (D42), Editorial Program Summary (D51), Festival Affiliation (D52), Active Showings Count (D53), Archived Showings Count (D54).
          

          

            What It Looks For & Validates: Performance, Schedule & Editorial Validator. Inspects published event program copy, doors vs curtain set times, supporting performer additions, age admission restrictions (19+ with 2 pieces of ID vs All Ages vs Licensed All Ages), and editorial description accuracy as show date approaches.
          

          

            Fatal Dealbreakers: Flags schedule drift, unannounced performer changes, missing age restriction warnings, or door/curtain mismatches. Stamps last_content_qc_at.
          

        


        
        

          

            

              Tier 3: Full Facility Audit (96D) (/qc-full)
            

            
              MONTHLY / SEASONAL (30-DAY SLA)
            
          

          

            All 96 Discrete Dimensions: Deep Stage 4–5 facility constants: Physical Civic Venue Name (D43), Civic Street Address Grounding (D44), Geocoded GPS Pin Alignment (D45), Venue Access Model (D46), Environment Type: indoor vs outdoor/patio (D47), Weekly Operating Hours (D48), Spend Benchmarks: craft beer pint & cocktail unit pricing (D49), Transit Waypoints & SkyTrain stations (D50), Civic Provider Option C Rules (D55), Data Provenance & Subagent Session Recording (D56), Curator Lock Status & Appeals (D57), Full QC Audited Timestamp (D58).
          

          

            What It Looks For & Validates: Exhaustive facility-level ground-truth audit. Extracts physical street addresses directly from venue's official /visit or /contact page, matches GPS coordinates to eliminate multi-location disambiguation errors (e.g. Vancouver Chinatown vs New Westminster branches), verifies seasonal operating hours, audits on-site craft beer/cocktail menu pricing, validates transit directions, and ensures civic parks/beaches use non-blocking Option C destination guides to prevent Cloudflare 403 blocks.
          

          

            Fatal Dealbreakers: Quarantines phantom venues, suburban branch address mismatches, or broken municipal links. Stamps last_full_qc_at.
